title: Allotment of Code to The Capital Stock Exchange of Kerala Ltd
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Allotment of Code to The Capital Stock Exchange of Kerala Ltd Jan 21, 2000| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMD/POLICY/CIR(DBA-II)- /2000 January 21, 2000 To, The President/Executive Directors/Managing Directors of All Stock Exchanges Dear Sir, Sub : Allotment of Code to The Capital Stock Exchange of Kerala Ltd. Please refer to our Circular No.SMD-I/22532 dated October 19, 1993, whereby codes were alloted to different Stock Exchanges. As you are aware that SEBI has recently recognised The Capital Stock Exchange of Kerala Ltd. Accordingly, The Capital Stock Exchange of Kerala Ltd. has been allotted Code No.25 and the members will be issued registration number beginning with INB25. For the purposes of trading and settlement operations, you are advised to inform the members of your Exchange accordingly. Yours faithfully, M D PATEL EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT
